A small desktop update: the main window now makes it clearer what to do first.

## Changed

- Until a phone is paired, every card except **Connection** is faded out and can't be clicked. Before, a fresh install showed Camera, Transforms, Stream output and the rest fully lit, even though none of their controls do anything without a phone. They light up as soon as you pair one.

The phone app has no changes in this release.

Found something broken? Open an issue and paste your **Copy diagnostics** report into it.
